modmenu.summaryTranslation.offlineskins-: Caches player skins for offline use.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.offlinesk:
OfflineSkins Reloaded for Fabric 26.3. Caches player skins for offline use.
Ported by VoreZ.
tooltip.DisablePlayerHeads: Hides player heads in the tab list.
tooltip.use.Mojang: Uses the official Minecraft skin and cape provider.
tooltip.use.Crafatar: Use this when Mojang servers don't respond or provide skins or capes.
tooltip.use.CustomServer:
Enable custom server for skins and capes.

The URLs listed below apply to both skins and capes.
tooltip.allowHTTP:
Allows custom skin and cape URLs to use HTTP.

HTTPS is still preferred, but HTTP can be useful for trusted providers that do not offer HTTPS yet.

If you use an unknown server, consider leaving this off.
option.use.server.from.list: Choose a preset server from the list
tooltip.use.server.from.list:
Lets you quickly configure Ely.by or GitHub.

    | Ely.by

You don't have to enter the URL yourself. The mod enters it automatically.

    | GitHub

You don't have to enter https://. You only need to enter the raw data of a GitHub repository.

For example:

    VoreZ78/Images/refs/heads/main/skins/%auto%

VoreZ78 is the GitHub user, and Images is the repository.

    | Custom

Any link

menu.faqs.default.skin.cape.title: How do I make my skin or cape load by default?
menu.faqs.default.skin.cape.answer:
Simply rename them using your nickname or turn on the Remember selected skin or Remember selected cape option.

    Example:

      cachedImages\skins\YourNickname.png 

    Example:

      cachedImages\capes\YourNickname.png

  This folder can be opened in the dressing room menu.
menu.faqs.cached.skin.cape.can.see.other: How to make other players see my cached skin or cape?

To make other players see your cached skin or cape, they must have your

    YourSkin.png

    or

    YourCape.png

 in the cachedImages folders.
menu.faqs.red.steve.cape.title: Why are other players' skins or capes shown as red Steve or a red cape with an exclamation mark?
menu.faqs.red.steve.cape.answer:
This happens because other players are using HD skins or capes.

 The mod replaces them with a red Steve skin or a red cape to optimize network performance, but this does not affect cached images.

 To display them normally, you have to allow HD players in the OfflineSkins Reloaded Network settings.
menu.faqs.remember.skin.cape.title: Why did my selected skin or cape disappear when I changed my nickname?
menu.faqs.remember.skin.cape.answer:
Because the mod remembers your selected skin and cape by your nickname.

When you change your nickname, the mod doesn't have a saved selection for the new nickname.
menu.faqs.skin.cape.wrong.title: Why are my or other players' skins or capes displayed incorrectly?
menu.faqs.skin.cape.wrong.answer:
This may happen when your enabled providers — 

   Mojang, Crafatar, and Custom Server — 

return different skins. To solve this, give priority to the provider you want to use.
menu.faqs.skin.cape.title: Why doesn't my local skin or cape show up?
menu.faqs.skin.cape.answer:
This can happen for three main reasons:

1. You didn't name your file correctly, so its name doesn't match your nickname. This can prevent your local skin or cape from being displayed in the game.

2. You put it in the wrong folder or directory. The correct ones are

    cachedImages\skins

    and

    cachedImages\capes

3. You didn't turn on the Remember selected skin or Remember selected cape option when selecting your skin or cape.
menu.faqs.cache.title: What will happen if I delete the cachedImages folder?
menu.faqs.cache.answer: All your local skins and capes will be deleted forever, but the folder will be automatically recreated.
menu.faqs.server.title: What is the order of the image providers' servers?
menu.faqs.server.answer:
From highest to lowest

    - cachedImages

    - Mojang

    - Crafatar

    - Custom Server
menu.faqs.links.title: What links does OfflineSkins Reloaded have?
menu.faqs.links.answer: All the links you can see here.
menu.faqs.bug.report.title: How can I report a bug about OfflineSkins Reloaded?
menu.faqs.bug.report.answer:
You can report a bug 🐞 by visiting the official OfflineSkins Reloaded Modrinth page, clicking the GitHub URL or visiting the VoriZoni Discord server.

Note: You have to sign in to GitHub.
